dimensions.assessment: Affects small business concerns seeking federal contracts and federal contracting officers across agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Each covered contract for goods or services that has an anticipated value greater than the simplified acquisition threshold shall be reserved for small business concerns

dimensions.assessment: Codifies an existing administrative practice into statute, altering the legal baseline for federal procurement preferences.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Small Business Act to codify the Rule of Two

dimensions.assessment: May shift portions of federal contract spending toward small businesses, but no specific fiscal dollar amounts are provided.
